sources.title: Accurate and Efficient Lighting for Skinned Models
sections: 4.1–4.3 Tangent transport, factors and reference bone
sources.scope: Technical text and equations for reconstructed gradients, extra zero-position-weight influences and tangent factors. No original code, figure or performance result adopted.

original_analysis: A four-face diamond uses piecewise affine bone weight max(x,0). Explicit equal averaging gives center estimate (1/2,0,0), despite zero stored position weight. Chosen tangent factors and a translated second bone yield normal (−1,0,2)/sqrt(5); the transform/index of that zero-position-weight bone remains required.
limits: The center is a kink, not a differentiable nonnegative interior zero with nonzero exact gradient.
Equal averaging is deliberately selected for this example, not claimed as faithful reproduction of the paper's cotangent/Voronoi preprocessing.
The estimated center normal is not each finite triangle's normal.
Tangent transport depends on the supplied shading plane; this is not a replacement for authored normals.
Discarding extra influences under a capacity limit is an approximation.
not_performed: Execution of preprocessing or shader code
preservation: Earlier triangle diagnostic remains unchanged; only its obsolete unread-paper exclusion is removed, and this separate source record covers the new section.
